title: EOMAP Extension
description: STAC EOMAP Extension for STAC Items and STAC Collections.

oneOf.$comment: This is the schema for STAC Items.
This is the schema for STAC Collections.

require_any_field.$comment: Items must carry at least one field of this extension in their properties.

fields.$comment: Fields of this extension; any other `eomap:` field is invalid.

eomap:products.title: Products
eomap:products.description: Codes of the EOMAP products contained, see vocabulary/products.json

eomap:product.title: Product
eomap:product.description: Code of the EOMAP product an asset belongs to

eomap:sensors.title: Sensors
eomap:sensors.description: Ids of the sensors the data is derived from, see vocabulary/sensors.json

eomap:country_code.title: Country code
eomap:country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code, or an EOMAP region code (GLO, INT)

eomap:vertical_datum.title: Vertical datum
eomap:vertical_datum.description: Vertical reference of heights and depths, see vocabulary/vertical-datums.json

eomap:tide_stations.title: Tide stations
eomap:tide_stations.description: Tide stations used for the vertical datum; levels in metres above chart datum

eomap:vertical_accuracy.title: Vertical accuracy
eomap:vertical_accuracy.description: Vertical accuracy in metres; omitted where a vertical uncertainty (VUC) product describes it per pixel

eomap:uuid.title: EOMAP UUID
eomap:uuid.description: Identifier written into the file (GeoTIFF tag EOMAP_UUID, ISO metadata fileIdentifier)

eomap:source.title: Source
eomap:source.description: System the record was created from

eomap:access.title: Access tags
eomap:access.description: Internal: who may see the record. Removed from responses for customers.

eomap:qa_flags.title: QA flags
eomap:qa_flags.description: Issues found while creating the record, for review
